metadata.title: Determinants of Dirichlet and Neumann Laplacians on Constant Curvature Surfaces with Geodesic Polygonal Boundary
metadata.abstract: We express the zeta regularized determinants of the Dirichlet and Neumann Laplacians on compact Riemann surfaces with constant curvature metrics and geodesic polygonal boundary in terms of the Laplacian determinant on their closed conical doubles. The formulae apply without restrictions on the genus or number of boundary components. They involve explicit corner angle factors and a quotient of the Reidemeister and $L^2$ norms on the determinant line of cohomology. The proof combines a relative BFK gluing formula with the comparison theorem for analytic and combinatorial torsion on manifolds with boundary, due to Lück and Vishik. As an application, we give a rigorous proof of the Aurell-Salomonson formula for Euclidean polygons. We also obtain explicit determinants for spherical and hyperbolic triangles and certain other geodesic polygons from known formulae for their doubles.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 奇异边界的谱行列式公式
analysis.workSummary: 对常曲率、测地多边形边界的紧 Riemann 曲面，将 Dirichlet 与 Neumann Laplacian 的 ζ 正则化行列式表示为闭合锥形双倍曲面上的行列式，并显式纳入角点因子及上同调行列式线上 Reidemeister 范数与 L² 范数之商。公式不限制亏格或边界分支数。
techniques: 相对 BFK 拼接公式
Lück–Vishik 边界解析挠率与组合挠率比较
analysis.breakthrough: 给出 Euclid 多边形 Aurell–Salomonson 公式的严格证明，并从已知双倍曲面公式推得球面、双曲三角形等例子的显式行列式。
analysis.limitations: 适用类为常曲率且边为测地线的紧曲面；Neumann 零模如何剔除、角点及上同调范数的归一化须看正文，不能当作任意边界度量公式。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。PDF 共 30 页，页数核对一致、文本完整提取且无短文本页。标准披露检索及补充的 A.I./A. I.、可断行模型名称与 AI 用语检索均未发现命中，因此本次未观察到作者自述 AI 使用披露；这不等同于确认未使用 AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 谱几何与奇异边界的可计算公式较有价值，适合关注 Laplacian 行列式、挠率和拼接技术的读者。
